anytime record on reg3_250 (TTF 7.1 s vs 16.1 s, 2.3×)** — the first TTF
record since 032. 0 of 3 moved a tc record (best delta +0.002 = tie).

- **059** (improve, parent 052-ladder): continuous β(span,t) freeze-out.
  Validator −0.1333, no record; huawei matched-sweep dev bench: −1.7 to
  −4.7 bits on ksg, wash on d13. Causal claim: freeze-out beats the hard
  gate as a *matched-work refiner*, but the 90 s primary budget is past
  the reg3 plateau where refinement quality stops mattering.
- **060** (improve, parent 052-ladder): activity-worklist freezing.
  Validator −0.4954, TTF ∞ — falsified on the primaries; dev bench split:
  −1.65/−1.72 bits on ksg at 30/75 s (throughput ×1.97), wash on d13.
  Causal claim: staleness pruning helps only where improvements localize;
  on expanders they don't.
- **061** (draft): targeted waist-band reheating. Validator −0.0315 with
  the confirmed reg3_250 TTF record; sycamore ttf 1.3 s claim unconfirmed
  (confirmation hit wall limit; recorded, not retried). Dev bench:
  final-tc side falsified as pre-registered (ksg +4–5 bits at matched
  sweeps; in-band net gain negative). Causal claim: band heating is an
  early-descent accelerant, not a refiner.

reflection.lessons:
1. **(top-ranked) The three mechanisms separate cleanly by *phase*, not by
   quality.** Observation: 061 wins the first 10 s (TTF 7.1 s), the
   cold ladder/059 wins matched-work refinement, plain annealing wins
   long budgets on expanders. Root cause (*confirmed* by the tc(t) curves
   and in/out-band gain accounting): early descent is bottleneck-
   negotiation (helped by local heat), late descent is plateau refinement
   (helped by cold, scale-ordered moves); a single homogeneous schedule
   cannot serve both. Evidence: 061 in-band net gain negative at 2048
   sweeps yet TTF 2.3× faster; 059 yield-rate *lower* while final tc
   better. Implication: the promoted direction is a *phase-switched
   composite* (band reheat → freeze-out front), one atomic change on 061.
2. **059 vs primaries.** Observation: big dev-bench wins, validator tie.
   Root cause (*confirmed*): reg3_250's 90 s frontier is a basin floor —
   13 mechanisms and 2 toolchains already saturate it (cycles 1–5); a
   better refiner cannot show there. Implication: matched-work refinement
   claims belong in the PR #40 ablation harness (paper), not on the
   saturated primary tc axis.
3. **060 falsification.** Observation: −0.75 on reg3. Root cause
   (*suspected*; would confirm with an activity-locality trace on reg3):
   uniform improvement density on expanders makes the worklist prune
   exactly the moves that matter; the periodic full sweeps then pay the
   pruning cost without the locality dividend. Implication: blacklist
   unconditional worklist scheduling; a locality-gated variant remains
   admissible but is not promoted.
4. *Off-goal:* the huawei dev benches (≤600 s, matched-sweep, parent
   toggle in-binary) proved a far cheaper falsification instrument than
   the 90 s validator pair — worth porting into the validator as a
   "mechanism mode" if cycle 12 is authorized.
reflection.evidence:

  061 both 39.882 = tie); **TTF record now 7.069 s (061, confirmed)**.
- Blacklist additions: unconditional activity-worklist scheduling (060);
  band reheating as a *refiner* (061 matched-sweep result).
- Standing risk: dev-set overfit — no holdout adjudication spent this
  cycle (single-record cycle; the record is an anytime axis the holdout
  set does not cover).
reflection.literature:
.knowledge/ contraction-order KB (60 refs): no prior work assigns
per-node scale- or cost-dependent temperatures inside a contraction-tree
SA; nearest neighbours remain multilevel partitioning (coarsen-refine,
already distinguished in attempt-034) and cotengra's reconf (subtree
re-optimization, no temperature structure). The phase-separation claim
(heat-for-descent vs cold-for-refinement on this landscape) appears
novel and is the publishable nugget of this cycle.
